text:
taylor: Heads up — the CLI sample app is spamming WARNs on startup in a way that leaks raw request IDs into logs (noticed during onboarding call).
taylor: Repro: run `./devx sample-app --auth local` on mac, watch logs. WARNs flood for ~10s then go away.
taylor: Example log: 
```
WARN 2026-03-22T14:12:03Z AuthRetry: auth failed, retrying, req_id=7c9f2b4a-... , user_email=dev+qa@acme.com
WARN 2026-03-22T14:12:04Z AuthRetry: auth failed, retrying, req_id=7c9f2b4a-... , user_email=dev+qa@acme.com
```
taylor: Two problems: noise level (warns for expected retry backoff) and PII in the log (email + full req_id).
sam: ack. can you paste the sample-app config? is this only Node CLI?
taylor: It's the node/sample-app default. config: `SAMPLE_AUTH=local` and `DEVX_TELEMETRY=on` (default).
arya: likely ordering issue — our otel request-id hook runs after the express/logger binding in the sample app, so logs get full headers before redaction middleware sets the masked id. Seen this before in a different repo.
arya: quick sketch: we need the otel context propagation (and redaction hook) to attach req.ctx.req_id before any logger middleware that prints request fields.
mike: parity note: Go SDK's logging middleware attaches a masked ID at the top of the handler chain, node SDK used to be inverted because of an earlier middleware shim. So node is the one spamming raw IDs.
jess: Curious: why are retries WARN and not DEBUG? That seems to be the DX pain — onboarding users panic when they see WARNs.
arya: Right — our AuthRetry emits WARN for first N attempts. For noisy environments (local dev w/ flaky creds) it should be INFO. We changed levels recently to surface auth problems for prod incidents but forgot the sample-app path.
taylor: Repro steps and easy local patch idea: swap the logger init and otel init in `sample-app/src/index.js`. Currently: 
```js
// current order
initLogger();
initExpress();
initOpenTelemetry();
```
change to: 
```js
initOpenTelemetry();
initLogger();
initExpress();
```
that should ensure request-id redaction runs before logger enricher.
sam: Can we make this a defensive change in the SDK instead? Relying on app init order is fragile.
arya: Agreed. SDK change: ensure our `logger.enrich(req)` consults `req.headers['x-request-id']` and if present masks it (e.g., keep last 8 chars) even if otel hasn't attached context yet. Also add a redact helper used by both SDKs.
mike: Will need to stereo-type across Go/Node/Python. I can PR a small `redactRequestId()` util in go-sdk and node-sdk. Add tests for header-only, otel-only and combined.
jess: Also update docs and sample-app templates so new projects don't inherit noisy config. Maybe set AuthRetry log level to INFO in templates.
eng-bot: CI report: node/sample-app unit tests failed on master — `telemetry:redaction` test timed out (flaky).
sam: I'll open a tracking ticket for: 1) SDK defensive redact helper, 2) sample-app init order in templates, 3) change AuthRetry default level to INFO for dev templates, 4) add telemetry e2e that asserts no raw emails/reqids in logs.
sam: Assigning to @taylor for sample-app PR and @mike for SDK utils.
taylor: I'm on the sample-app fix, will open PR with test by EOD.
mike: I'll start node-sdk patch and the test matrix. will ping when ready for review.
jess: Adding a docs blurb to the onboarding guide about noisy WARNs and how to suppress for local.
taylor: Thanks — also suggest we add a developer-facing flag `DEVX_TELEMETRY_MODE=quiet` to silence expected retry warnings locally. small QoL win.
sam: sounds good. prioritize SDK fix first, then sample-app and docs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
